english.notes:
Important Note:
Where a sex offender had been convicted / cautioned or a "finding" has been made in respect of him in relation to a relevant sexual offence by a court / police station outside of the United Kingdom AND the offender subsequently returns to the UK - this offence wording SHOULD NOT be used but a complaint should be laid before a Magistrates' Court.

To obtain an interim notification order a complaint must be laid by the Chief Constable. (The reference for the appropriate document for use by a court is a pseudo CJS Code - SX03505 (this is not available on custody suite systems).

The wording of such a complaint is:-

Application for a notification order on the ground that you have been

(A)_[convicted of a relevant offence,]_
(B)_[made the subject of a finding equivalent to a finding that you were not guilty by reason of insanity in respect of a relevant offence,]_
(C)_[made the subject of a finding equivalent to a finding that you were under a disability and did the act charged against you in respect of a relevant offence,]_
(D)_[cautioned in respect of a relevant offence, namely **(..GIVE THE DETAILS OF THE OFFENCE..), on **(..DATE OF CONVICTION/FINDING/CAUTION..) at **(..NAME OF FOREIGN COURT OR POLICE STATION..) under the law of **(..NAME OF COUNTRY..) , a country outside the United Kingdom]_

And the applicant applies, in accordance with section 100(2)(a) of the Sexual Offences Act 2003, for a hearing to take place on **(..DATE OF HEARING OF INTERIM APPLICATION..) at **(..TIME OF HEARING OF INTERIM APPLICATION..) at **(..COURT HOUSE..) for an interim notification order to be made until the main application is determined

In accordance with section 97 of the Sexual Offences Act 2003.
